text: 10月9日ETF市场资金面整体呈大幅净流入格局，九大类ETF中七类流入、两类流出，整体净流入约272.42亿元，资金流向呈现以下特征： 其一，宽基品种单日吸金177亿元，科技成长方向获集中增持。宽基指数ETF净流入居各大类之首，占整体净流入的六成以上；净流入TOP20榜单中宽基品种占据11席、合计净流入约133.42亿元，其中科创50方向2只产品合计净流入约44.57亿元，科创50ETF华夏以36.72亿元居净流入榜单第二位，创业板（21.46亿元）、中证1000（合计22.81亿元）、中证500（合计12.79亿元）方向同步获增持。 其二，半导体方向包
text_en: On October 9, the ETF market overall showed a large net inflow of funds. Among the nine major categories of ETFs, seven saw inflows and two saw outflows, with an overall net inflow of about RMB 27.242 billion. The fund flows showed the following characteristics: First, broad-based products attracted RMB 17.7 billion in a single day, with concentrated increases in the technology growth direction. Broad-based index ETFs ranked first among all major categories in net inflows, accounting for more than 60% of overall net inflows; in the top 20 net inflow list, broad-based products occupied 11 seats, with total net inflows of about RMB 13.342 billion, among which two products in the STAR 50 direction had total net inflows of about RMB 4.457 billion, and STAR 50 ETF Huaxia ranked second on the net inflow list with RMB 3.672 billion, while the ChiNext (RMB 2.146 billion), CSI 1000 (total RMB 2.281 billion), and CSI 500 (total RMB 1.279 billion) directions also saw increases.
